To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) we propose to generate a synthetic dataset of TIR sequences by translating RGB sequences to synthetic TIR sequences; (2) we show that a network that is trained on a large synthetic TIR dataset outperforms one trained on the real TIR data; and (3) we show that combining the network trained on the synthetic data with motion features outperforms the state of the arts by a relative gain of more than 10% on VOT-TIR 2017.

(i) we are the first ones to train end-to-en deep trackers for thermal infrared images, (ii) we show that using synthetic data improves tracking performance on real thermal infrared data, and (iii) we outperform state-of-the-art thermal infrared trackers by a large margin.
we propose a novel method for generating large synthetic TIR sequences from labeled RGB data.
